recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-37692 unless a separate tooling review finds missing validator/build enforcement outside this source checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-37692 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested unique ElementDefinition.constraint identifiers within a StructureDefinition, motivated by duplicate sdf-24 keys in StructureDefinition, and final resolution called for explicit specification language plus tooling/test enforcement with allowance for repeated appearances in derived sliced models.
initial_application: Two Jira-tagged commits applied the issue. d12d91aa9794795894290c713a9a8a687604c987 renamed the duplicate StructureDefinition constraint key from sdf-24 to sdf-28, and 39122085c8ac5594f8421a1ec1902e20b8bf6832 added source/conformance-rules.html language explaining that constraint keys identify constraints, are required to be unique when declared, and are validated for meaningful uniqueness where possible.
additional_context: The FHIR-I Zulip thread for FHIR-37692 explains that slicing and snapshots repeat inherited constraints, so a simple StructureDefinition-level invariant over all repeated constraint elements would be incorrect. The 2022-08-22 FHIR-I minutes record the reopen and final Persuasive with Mod vote. A later FHIR-37761 commit corrected the adjacent SDF-24/SDF-25 CodeableReference constraint expressions but did not alter the unique-key policy.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the active source already contains the approved policy wording and the originally cited duplicate key is absent from current StructureDefinition source.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the SDF-24/SDF-25 CodeableReference constraints adjacent to the duplicate-key area; useful background but not part of the FHIR-37692 uniqueness-policy decision.
